statement: The first line holds n; the second holds the row of n integers (n is at least two). Return the largest value stored in the row. Do not change the order of the values. The answer is a value from the row, not an index.

example.why: -2 is greater than every other value in the row.

hint: Keep one candidate from the row and compare each later value against that candidate.
mistake: Starting the candidate at 0 hides the answer when every stored value is negative.
